Question Explanation: Calculate work done by air drag during ball ascent.

Concept: Work-Energy Theorem.

Solution: The net work done by non-conservative forces (Wair​) equals the change in mechanical energy ΔME = (Kf ​+ Uf​) − (Ki ​+ Ui​).
The ball momentarily comes to rest at the top (Kf​ = 0).
m = 0.5kg. u = 14m/s. h = 9m. g = 9.8m/s2.
 
Uf​ = mgh = (0.5)(9.8)(9) = 44.1J.
Wair​ = (Kf ​+ Uf​) − (Ki ​+ Ui​) = (0 + 44.1J) − (49J + 0) = −4.9J.
"

Solution Explanation: 
1. Descending Limb:
  • The descending limb is highly permeable to water but relatively impermeable to solutes.
  • Water moves out of the filtrate by osmosis to equilibrate.
  • This results in the filtrate becoming more concentrated, hence hypertonic.

  • The ascending limb is impermeable to water but permeable to solutes particularly sodium and chloride ions.
  • Removal of solutes with out water movement diputes the filtrate.
  • This results in the filtrates becoming less concentrated, hence hypotonic.

Therefore
  • A = Hypotonic 
  • B = Hypertonic
Answer:
The correct answer is option 2: hypotonic, hypertonic."
